newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: CRICKET-BANGLADESH 243-7 V SCOTLAND IN ICC SEMIFINAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BANGLADESH 243-7 V SCOTLAND IN ICC SEMIFINAL.

text.p: Bangladesh scored 243 for seven in their 50 overs against Scotland in the International Cricket Council (ICC) Trophy semifinal on Tuesday.
Rain delays during the day prevented any further play and the match is to resume on Wednesday, with Scotland starting their reply.
The winners will play Kenya in Saturday's final of the tournament which is being staged to decide three qualifiers for the 1999 World Cup in England.
